chunks: This man was known as Kulayb al-Jarmi.

key_terms.الْجَرْمِيِّ: Al-Jarmi, a nisba indicating lineage or tribe (from Jarm).

ai.seo_question: Who is Kulayb al-Jarmi in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This phrase serves as a concise biographical identifier for Kulayb al-Jarmi, a prominent Basran companion of Imam Ali (AS) known for his role in the Battle of the Camel. It highlights the scholarly tradition of distinguishing individuals by their tribal affiliation (Jarmi) and geographic origin (Basra), providing essential context for understanding his political and theological stance during the early Islamic period.
